outline.rationale: User is a complete database beginner aiming to back a web/app project, so the outline starts from fundamentals (no skipped basics) and stays application-facing. Node 1 gets them a running instance to practice against. Nodes 2-3 build the relational model and SQL literacy from zero. Nodes 4-5 cover schema design and relationships, which are essential for any real app data model. Node 6 bridges to actual backend code (the stated goal). Node 7 covers migrations, a real shipping/maintenance need. Node 8 bundles practical correctness/safety concerns (transactions, basic indexing, injection prevention) without diving into deep DBA topics like replication, tuning, or internals, which were explicitly deprioritized. Nodes are largely non-overlapping and ordered by dependency.
